verify.title: Verify the person's identity?
verify.body: Record that you checked who made this {kind} request (Collective is the controller).

start.title: Start working on it?
start.body: The {kind} request moves to in progress.

fulfil.title: Fulfil the request?
fulfil.body: Access or portability: a JSON export of the login is produced. Erasure: the login's contact data is anonymised and the login disabled — refused while it still works for a tenant. ({kind})

reject.title: Reject the request?
reject.body: Explain why in the notes — the person is told. ({kind})

outbox.title: Event outbox
outbox.description: Domain events that failed to relay and subscriber deliveries that failed, with their last error. A replay publishes the stored event again; subscribers ignore an event they already processed.
outbox.messagesHint: Events the relay could not publish.
outbox.deliveriesHint: Events a subscriber could not process.
outbox.replayMessageBody: The stored {type} event is published again to every subscriber.
outbox.replayConsumptionBody: The stored {type} event is delivered again to this subscriber only.
